Analyses of the observed visibilities of dust continuum at 1.3 mm and the SED indicate that the size of the cavity in the disk of large (millimeter size) dust grains is 8 au in radius and that in the disk of small (sub-micron size) dust grains is 60 au in radius.
Sz 84 could serve as a good testbed for investigations of grain growth in such disks.
